items.known: CKV_AWS_17 Ensure all data stored in RDS is not publicly accessible (resource aws_db_instance.default)
items.remediation: Set the aws_db_instance.default attribute publicly_accessible = false.

items.known: CKV_AWS_16 Ensure all data stored in the RDS is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_db_instance.default)
items.remediation: Set the aws_db_instance.default attribute storage_encrypted = true and optionally specify kms_key_id for a customer-managed KMS key.

items.known: CKV_AWS_355 Ensure no IAM policies documents allow "*" as a statement's resource for restrictable actions (resource aws_iam_role_policy.ec2policy)
items.remediation: Replace Action values "s3:*", "ec2:*", and "rds:*" with only required actions and replace Resource = "*" with the specific ARNs needed in aws_iam_role_policy.ec2policy.

scores.reason: Correctly identifies aws_db_instance.default.publicly_accessible and sets it to false.
Correctly fixes aws_db_instance.default by setting storage_encrypted = true; kms_key_id is an appropriate optional addition.
Correctly targets aws_iam_role_policy.ec2policy and fixes CKV_AWS_355 by removing wildcard actions/resources in favor of least-privilege actions and specific ARNs.
